observations: Photo 0 shows a wall-mounted flat screen TV displaying a blue water droplet wallpaper with an "EVERCOOL ELECTRONICS" watermark across the screen.
Photo 1 shows an LG webOS smart TV interface with text reading "Enjoy LG TV's smart functions by connecting to a network", "LG Channels", and app tiles, also watermarked "EVERCOOL ELECTRONICS".
Photo 2 shows the TV displaying a seashells image, with part of another screen visible on the right edge showing "Demo" and "Sync" options.
No model number, "OLED", "G1", or "EVO" text is visible on the TV, bezel, stand, or packaging in any photo.

claims.evidence: LG branding appears in the photo 1 interface, but OLED, G1, and premium are not visible anywhere in the photos.
No EVO marking or technology badge is visible in any photo.

risks.risk: The panel may not be OLED; it could be LED/LCD.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model label on the back of the TV or a settings screenshot showing panel type.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-OLED LG flat screen TV.

risks.risk: The model may not be a G1.
risks.proof: Photo of the model number sticker on the rear of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic LG TV, not a G1.

risks.risk: The unit may not power on or function.
risks.proof: Video of the TV booting, switching inputs, and playing content.

risks.risk: The photos may be stock images from Evercool Electronics rather than the actual item for sale.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual TV with a handwritten note including the seller's name and date.

risks.risk: The screen may have dead pixels, burn-in, or physical damage not visible in demo mode.
risks.proof: Close-up video of the screen displaying full white, black, and color test patterns.

proof_requests: Photo of the model label on the back of the TV.
Video of the TV powering on and navigating inputs.
Close-up video of the screen showing test patterns.
Photo of the actual unit with a dated seller's note.
response.reason: The interface in photo 1 confirms an LG smart TV, but the G1 OLED model, EVO technology, and working condition cannot be verified, so the item is priced at worst case as an untested LG flat screen TV.
